title: NV Hotel w/ Pool, Gym, Rooftop Lounge & Free Park
description:
Welcome to Your Nashville Getaway Experience the best of Music City from this stylish 2-bedroom, 2 bath (Sleep 08) located just mins from downtown Nashville, this modern space offers the perfect mix of comfort and convenience.
Some Amenities:
✔ Full Kitchen 
✔ In-Unit Washer/Dryer
✔ Pool 
✔ Gym 
✔ Rooftop Lounge

You'll be close to Broadway’s live music, top restaurants, and local attractions. Whether you're here for a weekend getaway, work trip, or extended stay, this is the perfect home base.

The space
The Hotel Name is Haven At Charlotte

★ Apt Located on 8th Floor 
★ 4th floor -> Pool and GYM and Lobby work area
★ Clubhouse W/ Rooftop Pool
★ 24/7 Gym
★ Elevator Access – No need to worry about stairs!
★ Free & Fast Wifi across the building 

★10th floor > Sky lounge area
✔Work area
✔Billiard
✔Poker table
✔Foosball table

📍Location – Perfectly Situated!
✔ 5 min to Downtown Nashville
✔ 7 min to Broadway & Honky Tonks
✔ 6 min to The Gulch & Music Row
✔ 5 min to Vanderbilt University & Hospital
✔ 10 min to Nissan Stadium (Titans) & Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
✔ 15 min to Nashville International Airport (BNA)

Guest access
Complete access to all areas as shown!

Other things to note
★ Only One Key Fob is provided
★ Early Checkin / Late Checkout can be arranged. Dm to find out more
★ Parking is available but there is no designated parking for the property.
★ Public parking in garage is available and operates on a first-come, first-served basis! (Its very spacious and easy to find but difficult on weekend late nights)

★ New listing – book with confidence! Always available even for last minute stays, exactly as described, and ready to welcome you. 24/7 Customer Support

★ We also have another unit available on the same floor if you’d like to book both, feel free to DM!
